note: Town guard, front view, a weapon held low in the left (image-left) fist. Head is the brown hair, ears and full beard, bottom y~424 at the beard tip; the red collar, brown leather vest with its cross straps, blue tunic, belt, grey-blue trousers and the red cape ends at both hips are torso. Left arm is bent: blue shoulder sleeve with the brown pauldron is the upper arm (x312-394, y438-590) to the elbow y~590 where the sleeve ends, the brown leather bracer is the forearm (x286-356, y548-628) running left to the wrist x~300, and the bare fist with its fingers and the brown glove piece under it (x246-340, y606-706) is the hand. The weapon is hard to read: I labelled both the grey knob with its brown haft above the fist (x178-293, y455-612) and the big grey cleaver blade below it pointing down-left (x118-284, y648-796) as equipment, kept off the fist; they may be two ends of one pole-weapon. Right arm: brown pauldron and blue sleeve are the upper arm to the elbow y~590, the brown bracer is the forearm to the wrist y~646, the bare fist is the hand (y644-706). Trousers tucked into boots: hip at the crotch y~750, the boot cuffs at y~766 are above halfway so they are the knees (thigh is only the short trouser stub above them); boots are lower leg to the ankles (y~842), toes are feet.
